title: Legend & microcopy: keyboard announceability and locale-aware phrasing sweep
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: Several console panels (Routes list, Cost legend, Rollout status strip) have compact legend labels and tooltip microcopy that are not consistently announced by screen readers and do not adapt well to non-English locales. Problem: keyboard focus lands on small color swatches and compact labels without an accessible name or locale-sensitive phrasing; tooltips are only hover-based. Goals: 1) ensure every interactive legend/label is keyboard-focusable with a clear accessible name; 2) create a consistent microcopy pattern that supports translation, pluralization, and locale-specific number/date formatting; 3) convert hover-only tooltips to combined focus/hover tooltips and provide aria-live announcements for changes (e.g., rollout percentage update). This ticket scopes the design deliverables, content patterns, and validation checklist for the implementation sprint.
acceptance_criteria: All legend items and swatches have keyboard focus styles and programmatic accessible names (aria-label or aria-labelledby) in the prototype
Tooltip content is authored as translatable strings with pluralization rules and examples for at least EN, FR, DE, JP
Focused items trigger a non-intrusive announcement (aria-live polite / region) describing the item and its numeric state where applicable
Color contrast adjustments documented with target contrast ratios and fallback patterns for users who enable high-contrast mode
Design tokens and microcopy guidelines added to the Console style spec and shared with i18n and engineering
Prototype passes a lightweight screen reader walkthrough (NVDA + VoiceOver) and keyboard-only flow test documented in comments
design_notes: Use pattern: <label> + vis-hidden description + focusable swatch button for screen reader users; avoid redundant repetition for visual users
Microcopy must use ICU message format for numbers and pluralization; provide example keys like legend.rolloutPct = '{pct, number, percent} rollout'
Tooltips should have a visible trigger that is reachable via Tab and should not rely solely on hover events; dismissible via Esc
When a rollout percentage updates in-place, use aria-live region with polite priority and concise phrasing: 'Rollout to 30% complete'
For locales with longer strings, allow legend layout to flow to two lines and ensure focus ring remains visually distinct
Provide alternative visual indicators (pattern/texture) for color-only legends to support users with color deficiency

2026-03-04 Luca Ortega: Low-fidelity prototypes uploaded. I experimented with an aria-live polite pattern for rollout updates; left note about debounce so live region doesn't spam announcements during autoscaling bursts.
2026-03-06 PM review (Ravi Patel): Requested explicit examples for French plural rules and confirmation that JP date formatting will be applied to tooltip timestamps.

2026-03-08 Accessibility review (Anya Sokolov): Suggested increasing focus ring thickness to 3px on 1x baseline and adding texture patterns to color legend to meet WCAG for color-only information. Marked one microcopy item for rewrite: 'Active' -> 'Active rollout: {pct, number, percent}'.
2026-03-09 Engineering sync (ENG-4021): Eng asked for consolidated tokens and a single translation key namespace. Agreed to publish a tokens mapping table in the style spec doc.
2026-03-10 Luca Ortega: Updated prototype with high-contrast variants and example ICU messages for EN/FR/DE/JP. Ready for NVDA walkthrough. Leaving as In Review until screen reader pass recorded.
